## Procedure

1. Begin in the Form Start position (-13) at the starting line
2. When ready, sprint forward to the first line (5 yards) and touch it with the right hand (-37)
3. Turn and sprint back to the starting line and touch it with the left hand
4. Turn and sprint to the second line (10 yards) and touch it with the right hand
5. Turn and sprint back to the starting line and touch it with the left hand
6. Turn and sprint to the first line again (5 yards), touch it with the right hand, then turn and sprint past the starting line
7. Perform this drill using the following distances: 10 yards - 5 yards - 10 yards, 5 yards - 5 yards - 5 yards, 5 yards - 10 yards - 15 yards, and 15 yards - 10 yards - 5 yards
